# Design tokens

A token is a CSS custom property. A theme's block (`.<id>`) sets most of them; `styles/tokens.css` sets the motion tokens and maps them to Tailwind (`@theme inline`), so `bg-primary`, `rounded-lg`, `shadow-md`, `text-md` all resolve through tokens. Values below are the default theme's (Berghain); `themes-resolved.md` has every theme's values. "Applied in" is sampled from component source: the three components that use the token most (not exhaustive).

Counts: 179 custom properties, 47 token-backed classes (`text-*`, `glass-*`).

## Typescale by step

Body steps use line-height 1.6, heading steps 1.4. Sizes (px) per `scale` mode are in `themes.md`. Tailwind sizes map as: text-xs→xs, text-sm→sm, text-base→md, text-lg→lg, text-xl→lg, text-2xl→h6, text-3xl→h5, text-4xl→h4, text-5xl→h3, text-6xl→h2, text-7xl→h1.

## Motion tokens

Easing curves (`--ease-<group>-<strength>`):

| Token | cubic-bezier |
|---|---|
| `--ease-in-out-normal` | cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 0.2, 1) |
| `--ease-in-out-slight` | cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) |
| `--ease-in-out-strong` | cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.04, 1) |
| `--ease-in-out-back` | cubic-bezier(0.4, -0.6, 0.6, 1.6) |
| `--ease-in-normal` | cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 1, 0.8) |
| `--ease-in-strong` | cubic-bezier(0.95, 0, 1, 1) |
| `--ease-in-back` | cubic-bezier(0.4, -0.4, 1, 0.8) |
| `--ease-out-normal` | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.35, 1) |
| `--ease-out-strong` | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.02, 1) |
| `--ease-out-back` | cubic-bezier(0, 0.4, 0.4, 1.4) |
| `--ease-out-in-transition-out-in` | cubic-bezier(0, 0.7, 1, 0.3) |

Springs (bounce): subtle 0.5, normal 0.7005, expressive 0.75. Timing (s): instant 0, fast 0.2, faster 0.4, long 0.8, longer 1.2, longest 2.4. Hold: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1).

Component Animations choices:

| Choice | Easing | Duration | Spring bounce |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | — | 0s | — |
| ease | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.35, 1) | 0.8s | — |
| emphatic | cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 0.2, 1) | 0.4s | — |
| springy | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.35, 1) | 0.8s | 0.7005 |

Page-transition speeds: slow 1.2s, medium 0.8s, fast 0.4s.
